name: design-agent-skills
description: Design skills for AI agents to understand products, explore design options, and prepare clear implementation handoffs.

interface.longDescription:
DAS helps agents understand product context, review interfaces, and explore design directions. It carries your approved choices into implementation requirements and a developer handoff, then checks the built result against them. Use the skills with your product sources, design system, and available tools.

Version 0.1.0 supports the documented Codex app and CLI workflows. Claude support is under development and is not part of this release.
defaultPrompt: Review this interface and recommend what to change.
Explore design directions for this product.
Check the implementation against the approved design.
